overview_description.description: OPIO is a clothing and lifestyle brand that is crafted in Egypt designed for the women on-the-go, who want to look fashionable and timeless. It’s known for its effortless and easy to wear style that can be worn from day tonight. OPIO pieces are instantly recognizable with their clean lines, subtle detailing, and soft quality textiles, creating an effortlessly chic look. they are specially created for a generation of free spirits, role jugglers, deep souls, young hearts, outgoing, and laid back who wants to look good without too much effort.
